sentences.text: Agentic AI is reaching core compliance work: Deutsche Bank has put agents into production on KYC onboarding, a story carried by eight outlets.

Among other Tier 1 banks, HSBC announced AI to process and review trade finance documentation, and Bank of America is using its virtual assistant for internal self-service, cutting help desk inquiries.
Agents are starting to move money in pilots: Danske Bank, Rogers Bank and Revolut completed agentic payments, and GoCardless used an agent to transfer real money from a UK bank account.
NatWest is piloting voice and text conversations that let customers explore their finances.
